description: This file contains source code for managing an angel server in a lighttpd-related project. It includes functions for creating and freeing the server, handling signals, managing instances and their states, and handling angel connections and callbacks.

classes.name: liServer
classes.description: Represents the angel server with event loop, signal watchers, and plugins.

classes.name: liInstance
classes.description: Represents an instance of a process managed by the server, including its state, process info, and connections.

classes.name: liInstanceConf
classes.description: Configuration for creating a new instance, including command, environment, user info, and resource limits.

classes.name: liInstanceResource
classes.description: Represents a resource linked to an instance, with a callback for freeing it.

methods.name: void sigint_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback for handling SIGINT signal, stops the server.

methods.name: void sigpipe_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback for handling SIGPIPE, currently ignored.

methods.name: liServer * li_server_new(const gchar * module_dir,gboolean module_resident)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new angel server.

methods.name: void li_server_free(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a server.

methods.name: void li_server_stop(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Stops the server and its event loop.

methods.name: void instance_angel_call_cb(liAngelConnection * acon,const gchar * mod,gsize mod_len,const gchar * action,gsize action_len,gint32 id,GString * data)
methods.description: Handles angel calls from connections, routing to plugin callbacks.

methods.name: void instance_angel_close_cb(liAngelConnection * acon,GError * err)
methods.description: Callback when an angel connection is closed, logs accordingly.

methods.name: void instance_child_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Handles child process exit events, updates instance state.

methods.name: void instance_spawn_setup(gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Sets up file descriptors for a new instance process.

methods.name: void instance_spawn(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Spawns a new instance process, establishing angel connection and process management.

methods.name: liInstance * li_server_new_instance(liServer * srv,liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Creates a new server instance based on provided configuration.

methods.name: gboolean li_instance_replace(liInstance * oldi,liInstance * newi)
methods.description: Replaces an old instance with a new one, managing references.

methods.name: void li_instance_unset_replace(liInstance * oldi,liInstance * newi)
methods.description: Unsets replace relationships between instances.

methods.name: void li_instance_set_state(liInstance * i,liInstanceState s)
methods.description: Sets the desired state of an instance, triggering spawn or control commands.

methods.name: void li_instance_state_reached(liInstance * i,liInstanceState s)
methods.description: Handles transitions between instance states, triggering actions and notifications.

methods.name: void li_instance_release(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Decrements reference count and frees the instance if no longer used.

methods.name: void li_instance_acquire(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Increments the reference count of an instance.

methods.name: liInstanceConf * li_instance_conf_new(gchar ** cmd,gchar ** env,GString * username,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile)
methods.description: Creates a new instance configuration.

methods.name: void li_instance_conf_release(liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an instance configuration.

methods.name: void li_instance_conf_acquire(liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Increments the reference count of an instance configuration.

methods.name: void li_instance_add_resource(liInstance * i,liInstanceResource * res,liInstanceResourceFreeCB free_cb,liPlugin * p,gpointer data)
methods.description: Adds a resource to an instance.

methods.name: void li_instance_rem_resource(liInstance * i,liInstanceResource * res)
methods.description: Removes a resource from an instance.

ctags.name: instance_angel_call_cb
ctags.signature: (liAngelConnection * acon,const gchar * mod,gsize mod_len,const gchar * action,gsize action_len,gint32 id,GString * data)

ctags.name: li_instance_conf_new
ctags.pattern: /^liInstanceConf* li_instance_conf_new(gchar **cmd, gchar **env, GString *username, uid_t uid, gid/
ctags.signature: (gchar ** cmd,gchar ** env,GString * username,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile)
